mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market that signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 9.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity contracts.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% monthly signals late-cycle economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing activity weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers expectations of monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets price in rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Negative retail sales growth (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as demand-driven corporate revenue growth stalls.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth rate is negative, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases (>0.2pp) and employment growth declines (<0.1% monthly) signal accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% (GDPC1) signals economic deceleration that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face sustained headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
